card.name: Words describing growth or change trends
card.fires_on: Words in general web text about social, economic or environmental trends, often an adverb or noun marking degree or scale, such as 'increasingly', 'rapidly', 'in large numbers', or 'alarming rates'.

modes.label: Degree adverbs of change
